About Weather Pulse

Weather Pulse is a free site for weather forecasts, magnetic storms and public holidays, with no registration and no paid features. You can install it as an app on your phone from the browser menu.

What the site offers

  • Weather Forecast — 16 days and hourly, with a range of certainty, a comparison of models, sunrise, sunset and the phase of the Moon;
  • Magnetic Storms — the Kp index in real time, a 3-day forecast, solar wind and storm alerts;
  • Weather Maps — wind, rain, clouds and temperature;
  • Holiday Calendar — the public holidays of the country of the chosen place;
  • Moon calendar and The Sky — Moon phases, meteor showers, eclipses and supermoons;

Where the data come from

  • The weather forecast is from Open-Meteo, which uses the models of ECMWF (Europe), ICON (Germany), GFS (USA) and other weather services.
  • The data on magnetic storms and the solar wind are from the NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center.
  • Public holidays are from Nager.Date.
  • The maps are from Windy.

More details are on the Data Sources page.

How the forecasts are made

The weather forecast is calculated by numerical models that simulate the atmosphere on a grid of points. Besides the main forecast we also show a range of ensemble forecasts: the model is run many times with slightly different starting conditions, and the closer the results are, the more certain the forecast. A forecast is usually accurate for 3–5 days and only indicative after 7 days.

The magnetic storm forecast comes from the NOAA forecasters, who watch the Sun with satellites. More about it is on the Magnetic Storms page.
